trophies.name: Arisen
trophies.description: A testament to the knowledge gained from both worlds after many adventures and even more battles.

trophies.name: Emissary of Liberation
trophies.description: Defeat Lord Balseph. Keep the flag of liberation raised high. The fight has only just begun.

trophies.name: Vanquishers of Darkness
trophies.description: Defeat Lord Ganabelt, bringing light to Cyslodia and its people for the first time in centuries.

trophies.name: Comrades in Freedom
trophies.description: Recruit Lord Dohalim to your ranks. With friends like him, the Crown Contest's days are numbered.

trophies.name: Retired Avenger
trophies.description: Defeat Lord Almeidrea. A lone boy is all that stood between her and death by one of her victims.

trophies.name: Liberator of Dahna
trophies.description: Defeat Lord Vholran. With all the Renan lords deposed, Dahna is now free at last.

trophies.name: Invasion Averted
trophies.description: Stop the lights from the wedge. The Rena have stolen more than enough from Dahna as it is.

trophies.name: The Truth
trophies.description: Learn the truth about Dahna and Rena on Daeq Faezol. Now to take the fight to the Great Spirit.

trophies.name: Destined Liberator
trophies.description: Save both worlds from impending destruction. A bright future awaits the people of the new world.

trophies.name: Wall Smasher
trophies.description: Forge strong bonds with all party members as a testament to all the many hours spent together.

trophies.name: Intertwining Hearts
trophies.description: Forge a strong bond with Shionne, sharing your first meal together again, and plenty more...

trophies.name: An Honest Mage
trophies.description: Forge a strong bond with Rinwell, helping her come to terms with her lineage and feelings.

trophies.name: Role Model
trophies.description: Forge a strong bond with Law, giving him something to aspire to on and off the battlefield.

trophies.name: A Modest Dream
trophies.description: Forge a strong bond with Kisara, reminding her it's good to dream a little.

trophies.name: Drink 'til You Drop
trophies.description: Forge a strong bond with Dohalim, becoming drinking buddies with a one-time lord.

trophies.name: Owl Homecoming
trophies.description: Find and report all of the owls. Even with his cohorts back, Hootle's place remains with Rinwell.

trophies.name: Rebellious Spark
trophies.description: Clear your first sub-quest in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Problem Solver
trophies.description: Clear 70 sub-quests in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Skilled Angler
trophies.description: Catch your first fish in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Godly Angler
trophies.description: Catch every fish type and show the Notes to the Expert in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Speedy Chef
trophies.description: Cook your first meal in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Globetrotting Foodie
trophies.description: Acquire 30 kinds of non-DLC recipes in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Arms Stockpiler
trophies.description: Forge 100 types of weapons in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Jeweler
trophies.description: Craft 30 accessories in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: What's in a Name?
trophies.description: Learn your first non-DLC title skill in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Myriad Monikers
trophies.description: Learn 400 non-DLC title skills in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Hundred-Hit Smackdown
trophies.description: Get over 100 hits in a combo in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: One-Hit Wonder
trophies.description: Deal 10000 or more damage in one hit in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Diligent Counterattacker
trophies.description: Perform 100 Counter Edges in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: High Roller
trophies.description: Spend 400000 gald in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Peak Strength
trophies.description: Reach level 100 in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Encyclopedia Zeuglica
trophies.description: Encounter 120 types of non-DLC enemies in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Unrelenting Blaze
trophies.description: Defeat Efreet Malum. What was once a small spark grew to consume even the flaming giant.

trophies.name: Night Blossom
trophies.description: Defeat Meneiys. If only there had been time to admire the Phantom Flower just a little longer...

trophies.name: Quaking Continent
trophies.description: Defeat Grand Gnome. So enormous was its body that it dwarfed even the ruins surrounding it.

trophies.name: Billowing Cyclone
trophies.description: Defeat Procella Sylph. Soaring the skies on its back will forever remain a cherished memory.

trophies.name: Raging Current
trophies.description: Defeat Luo Undine. Even its heft couldn't stop it from being washed away by the party's might.

trophies.name: Big Game Hunter
trophies.description: Slay 20 gigants in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Otherworldly Survivor
trophies.description: Clear the "Otherworldly Visitors" sub-quest and bring about a reunion between a certain pair.

trophies.name: Putting the Past in its Place
trophies.description: Clear the "Reminiscence Device" sub-quest. No past foe is any trouble for today's party!

trophies.name: Elite Vanguard
trophies.description: Clear Ultimate level of group training ground fights in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Dilettante
trophies.description: Obtain your first non-DLC artifact in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Curious Hobbyist
trophies.description: Obtain 20 types of non-DLC artifacts in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Novice Rancher
trophies.description: Collect your first harvest on the ranch in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Veteran Rancher
trophies.description: Collect 50 harvests on the ranch in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: Owl Spotter
trophies.description: Find and report 13 owls. The lonely forest is beginning to show signs of feathered life.

trophies.name: Owl Scouter
trophies.description: Find and report 32 owls. The forest is now starting to teem with hordes of hooting owls galore.

trophies.name: Ceaseless Chatterbox
trophies.description: View 300 skits in the Tales of Arise™ main game story.

trophies.name: The First Seal
trophies.description: Seal Mausoleum of the Ruins: Helgal-Ryugola 238. A necessary act to bring peace to the new world.

trophies.name: Resolution
trophies.description: Defend the city from the zeugle threat and subdue the chaos.

trophies.name: True Freedom
trophies.description: Commit to living in the new world. For the day when all binds are cut loose.

trophies.name: The Second Seal
trophies.description: Seal Mausoleum of the Jungle: Helgal-Ryugola 67. A new destination awaits the party.

trophies.name: Departure
trophies.description: You'll see her again someday.

trophies.name: Arms Master
trophies.description: Craft 6 weapon types using ryugola core fragments in the Tales of Arise™ additional story.

trophies.name: Unparalleled Problem Solver
trophies.description: Clear 40 sub-quests in the Tales of Arise™ additional story.

trophies.name: Individual Growth
trophies.description: Clear 12 character sub-quests in the Tales of Arise™ additional story.

trophies.name: Always on Her Mind
trophies.description: Find portraits of every party member. Each drawing is brimming with sentiment.

trophies.name: Hero of the Summit
trophies.description: Dive from the highest place in the keystone's Whirlpool Palace. Perhaps not its intended purpose.

trophies.name: Elite Vanguard, Again
trophies.description: Clear Ultimate level of group training ground fights in the Tales of Arise™ additional story.
